newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans down in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine soybeans drifted down in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with little buying interest in the absence of clear signs from Chicago, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for May beans slipped $3 to $285 in Buenos Aires. Buenos Aires sunflower seed was unchanged at $215 in low volume. Maize was unchanged in low volume, with spot prices steady at $111 in Buenos Aires. Bahia Blanca wheat rose $2 to $146, with millers seeking to buy but not much exporter interest.
